technology_name: A METHOD FOR DEVELOPING MAGNESIUM-BASED MULTIFUNCTIONAL COMPOSITE COATING FOR METALLIC BONE IMPLANTS
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
problem_solved: Metallic bone implants suffer from rapid biological corrosion, poor tissue integration, and are highly prone to post-surgical bacterial infection.
description: An advanced liquid processing method to apply a multifunctional composite coating embedded with hydroxyapatite, magnesium oxide, and precise antibiotic doses directly onto orthopedic implants to accelerate cell growth and eliminate surgical revisions.
applications: Orthopedic surgical bone plates, load-bearing joint replacement screws, dental implant fixture coatings, and bio-absorbable internal fixation hardware.
